description: This Java class represents web site configuration properties for the Apache OFBiz framework, including URL settings, ports, hosts, and HTTPS enablement. It provides methods to initialize from properties files, web entities, or HTTP requests, and supports adjustments like port offsets.

classes.name: WebSiteProperties
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating web site URL configurations, ports, hostnames, web app path, and HTTPS settings, with methods for creation, modification, and adjustment based on server context or entity data.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Creates a WebSiteProperties instance with default settings from properties files.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method that initializes WebSiteProperties from an HttpServletRequest, possibly fetching entity data for site-specific configuration.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method that initializes WebSiteProperties from a WebSite entity value.

methods.name: addPortOffset
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with HTTP and optionally HTTPS ports adjusted by the port offset.

methods.name: updateHttpPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated HTTP port.

methods.name: updateHttpHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated HTTP host.

methods.name: updateHttpsPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated HTTPS port.

methods.name: updateHttpsHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated HTTPS host.

methods.name: updateWebappPath
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated webapp path, trimming trailing slash if present.

methods.name: updateEnableHttps
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties instance with updated HTTPS enablement flag.

methods.name: getEnableHttps
methods.description: Returns true if HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the WebSiteProperties object, listing all configuration properties.
